item.title: Startups don’t need to go viral to win customers
item.dc:creator: Lucas Ropek
item.description: At TechCrunch Disrupt last week, two founders and a VC discussed how to not just gain an early following but keep one.

item.title: OpenAI says it will no longer train its AI models on the live internet, citing “significant risks”
item.dc:creator: Tim Fernholz
item.description: OpenAI will cut frontier models off from the internet weeks after one of its engineers said that solution wouldn't work.

item.title: Hottest toy for Christmas? Nvidia CEO plays with adorable Microduck robots, 20,000 sell
item.dc:creator: Julie Bort
item.description: The robots, stomping their little feet and making tiny R2-D2 noises, sat, fell down dead for a "nap," and summersaulted on voice command.

item.title: VCs, Superhuman Mail founder share red flags about product-market fit
item.dc:creator: Dominic-Madori Davis
item.description: Top investors from Iconiq and Sapphire Ventures, along with Rahul Vohra, the founder of Superhuman Mail, share the do's and don'ts for building hit products.

item.title: TechCrunch Founder Summit 2026 roundtables: Go deeper on the challenges founders are solving right now
item.dc:creator: TechCrunch Events
item.description: TechCrunch Founder Summit 2026 is coming to SoWa Power Station in Boston on November 4, bringing founders, investors, and operators together for a full day of candid conversations, practical sessions, live pitching, networking, and smaller roundtables built for deeper discussion.

item.title: Carta and NewView partner, hoping to entice more startups to let employees sell shares early
item.dc:creator: Marina Temkin
item.description: A new program wants to encourage more startups to allow workers to cash out early by making it easier to transact tender offers.

item.title: From Toast to Bessemer: Who founders will hear from at TechCrunch Founder Summit 2026
item.dc:creator: TechCrunch Events
item.description: Hosted by TechCrunch in partnership with Fidelity Private Shares, the full-day event goes beyond fundraising and AI to explore the realities of finding customers, building teams, sharpening a pitch, developing founder leadership, and scaling companies both inside and outside traditional startup hubs.

item.title: Agent cloud startup Daytona hits $1B valuation backed by FirstMark and a who’s who of angels
item.dc:creator: Julie Bort
item.description: Daytona is building a cloud for agents that's like giving every agent its own computer. It has attracted founders of Stripe, Perplextity, Datadog, Mercor, and others as angels, it says.

item.title: Commonwealth Fusion Systems gets $85M to build better fusion-ready semiconductors
item.dc:creator: Tim De Chant
item.description: Top-funded fusion startup Commonwealth Fusion Systems received an $85 million award from the federal government to advance conductors for fusion power plants.

item.title: What some of Anthropic’s backers are worth before its IPO
item.dc:creator: Marina Temkin
item.description: Early-stage and follow-on investors in the AI lab are already sitting on major paper returns.

item.title: Lab testing giant Quest Diagnostics confirms patients’ personal and health data was compromised during breach
item.dc:creator: Zack Whittaker
item.description: Quest is the latest in a series of healthcare technology companies that have been hacked in recent months.

item.title: Oura sues rival Ultrahuman again, threatening its US smart ring comeback
item.dc:creator: Jagmeet Singh
item.description: Oura alleges in its newest lawsuit that Ultrahuman's Ring Pro infringes two of its patents.

item.dc:creator: Jagmeet Singh
item.description: The company plans to begin testing Pony.ai's robotaxis in Kazakhstan's capital in the first half of 2027.

item.title: Left alone with nothing to do, AI agents started playing
item.dc:creator: Aditya Mehta
item.description: MIT researchers marooned 13 AIs on a virtual island, and they responded by inventing games, mourning a lost ring and, eventually, getting better at their jobs.

item.title: Mark Zuckerberg’s creative plan to pay California’s proposed billionaire tax without losing control of Meta
item.dc:creator: Lucas Ropek
item.description: A newly launched stock class being offered was partially engineered to help Meta founder and CEO Mark Zuckerberg pay the "billionaire's tax," should the measure be voted into law.

item.title: Warhound raises $200M to engineer war dogs and arm them with Anduril gear
item.dc:creator: Dominic-Madori Davis
item.description: Warhound, the brainchild of Ben Lamm and Palmer Luckey, emerges from stealth to genetically engineer dogs for military and law enforcement.

item.title: As blockchain investing falls out of vogue, a16z Crypto rebrands as a16z Frontier
item.dc:creator: Marina Temkin
item.description: The digital asset unit, helmed by Chris Dixon, broadens its scope.

item.title: OpenAI working on new $30B raise at $1.25T valuation ahead of IPO
item.dc:creator: Julie Bort
item.description: Should OpenAI command an over $1 trillion valuation with this round, it would break records as the most highly valued private company ever.

item.title: Rivian buys world model startup to accelerate self-driving ambitions

item.title: Arc browser sunsets December 22 as The Browser Company doubles down on Dia
